items.title: David Weinstein Interview, 1988-09-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Trevor Richards has something. See people collecting your records still.

ctx.x: Well, that was done down here. We made a record down here. And one side of that was Yes She Does, No She Don't, and I forget the Everybody Lows My Baby or something like that was on the other side. Yeah, I remember that. We made that in the Roosevelt Hotel. And strangely enough, the guy who founded Decca was the guy who recorded that thing. It was the name Cap. Dave or Jack, one of the two. Yeah, he was in, he was the one that made the session. I remember that.
Trevor Richards has something. See people collecting your records still.
Can I buy them back? Like TV rights, huh?
